panels.title: Exporter queue size

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ' ', Attributes['data_type']) AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'otelcol_exporter_queue_size' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Batches waiting in each exporter's sending queue. Grows while the next hop is down, drains after.

panels.title: Refused by receivers / min

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'otelcol_receiver_refused_', '')) AS series,
         Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                  ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_refused_%' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Items rejected at the receiver, usually by the memory limiter. Senders retry them.

panels.title: Send failed / min

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_', '')) AS series,
         Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                  ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_%' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Items dropped after the exporter gave up. Retries never expire here, so only permanent errors count. Empty means none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, if(MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_%', concat('accepted ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_', '')), concat('sent ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'otelcol_exporter_sent_', ''))) AS series,
         Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                  ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] LIKE 'otel-gateway-%' AND (MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_%' OR MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_exporter_sent_%') AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Parts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ' ', replaceRegexpOne(MetricName, '^ClickHouse[A-Za-z]+_', '')) AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_MaxPartCountForPartition', 'ClickHouseMetrics_PartsActive') AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: MaxPartCountForPartition approaching parts_to_delay_insert (1000 by default) means inserts are too small or merges lag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'ClickHouseProfileEvents_', '')) AS series,
         Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                  ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName IN ('ClickHouseProfileEvents_FailedInsertQuery', 'ClickHouseProfileEvents_RejectedInserts', 'ClickHouseProfileEvents_DelayedInserts') AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS series,
         Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                  ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertQuery' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_ReplicasMaxAbsoluteDelay' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Read-only replicas

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'ClickHouseMetrics_ReadonlyReplica' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: A replica that lost Keeper turns read-only and refuses inserts.

panels.title: Dropped events / min

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, concat(concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], '/', ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']), ' ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'cnpg_pg_stat_ch_', '')) AS series,
         Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                  ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName IN ('cnpg_pg_stat_ch_dropped_events', 'cnpg_pg_stat_ch_dsa_oom_count', 'cnpg_pg_stat_ch_send_failures') AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Events lost inside PostgreSQL: queue full, shared memory exhausted, or export failed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], '/', ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS series, max(Value) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_ch_queue_usage_pct' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time
